description: This Java class 'LoggingConnectionEventProducer' implements the 'ConnectionEventProducer' interface to log connection events (connect and disconnect) at INFO level using SLF4J. It provides a simple logging mechanism for connection events within the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: LoggingConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: A logging implementation of the ConnectionEventProducer interface that logs connection and disconnection events.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Logs a connection event with details including remote ID, protocol adapter, device, and data.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Logs a disconnection event with details including remote ID, protocol adapter, device, and data.
